words.zh: 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的
words.ex_en: The refugees come across the border in vast numbers.

words.zh: 流产，堕胎，小产；流产的胎儿；（计划等）失败，夭折
words.ex_en: She decided to have an abortion .
Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
words.ex_zh: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

words.zh: 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的
words.ex_en: The pollsters asked a representative sample of New York residents for their opinions.
words.ex_zh: 民意调查员向一些有代表性的纽约居民征询了意见。

words.ex_en: Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
words.ex_zh: 我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？

words.ex_en: He’s merely a boy – you can’t expect him to understand.
words.ex_zh: 他只是个孩子——你不要指望他能理解。

words.zh: 块，团；群众，民众；大量，众多；质量
words.ex_en: The road was blocked by a solid mass of protesters.
words.ex_zh: 道路被密密麻麻的抗议者阻塞了。

words.ex_en: Official figures show a sharp decline in the number of foreign tourists.
words.ex_zh: 官方数字显示外国游客数量骤降。

words.ex_en: He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest.
words.ex_zh: 他撩起T恤衫，露出横贯胸部的锯齿状伤疤。

words.zh: 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的

words.ex_en: Unfortunately, you were out when we called.
words.ex_zh: 很遗憾，我们来的时候你出去了。

words.ex_en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
words.ex_zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

words.ex_en: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
words.ex_zh: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

words.ex_en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
words.ex_zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

words.zh: 典型的；特有的；表示特性的
words.ex_en: the highly characteristic (= very typical ) flint walls of the local houses
words.ex_zh: 当地房子非常有特色的燧石墙

words.zh: 投，抛；计算；浇铸；投射（光、影、视线等）
words.ex_en: the shade cast by low-hanging branches
words.ex_zh: 低垂的树枝投下的阴影

words.ex_en: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
words.ex_zh: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

words.ex_en: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
words.ex_zh: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

words.zh: 添加；[数] 加法；增加物
words.ex_en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
words.ex_zh: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。
